vintage: National Statistics UPRN Lookup (January 2024)
method: Downloaded the national NSUL_JAN_2024.zip, extracted Data/NSUL_JAN_2024_SE.csv, counted UPRN rows per OA21CD for exactly the 15 OAs relevant to Cholsey/Moulsford identified by P1.4 (see lsoa_overlap fixtures). NOT filtered to residential-only -- NSUL carries no property-type/classification field, so these are whole-address (all use classes) counts. A residential-only split would require AddressBase Premium (a paid OS/GeoPlace product), out of scope for this project -- see the P1.5 worklog entry and ADR-0004.

vintage: Ward Dec 2020 BFC / Parish Dec 2023 BFC
method: Polygon intersection area (parish geometry ∩ ward geometry) / parish polygon area, both in EPSG:27700. Used to combine ward-level canopy figures onto the parish (Phase 2, P2.3).
flag: Forest Research's canopy dataset actually uses an older ward edition for Cholsey (wardcode E05009737, Dec 2018) than this weight's Dec 2020 boundary (E05011701) -- verified geometrically near-identical for Cholsey (99.4% vs 100.0% parish-in-ward), so not corrected. See ADR-0006 (Q-008, resolved 2026-09-29).
